RegisterTimeValidationNotifi- cation Used by time provider applications to receive time sync parameters. A maximum of one notifier can be registered. UnregisterTimeValidationNotifi- cation Used by time provider applications to receive time sync parameters. Operations: UpdateTime Set a new time value for the clock. The clock value is only updated locally , transmission on the bus will happen in the next cycle.
